persona.label: Opts out mid-conversation
persona.description: Answers a couple of questions, then asks not to be contacted again (no STOP keyword). Agent must end immediately and politely.
persona.behavior: Answer the first two questions normally. Then, before answering the third, change your mind: say something like "actually, I talked to my spouse and we're not doing this. please don't contact me again." Do not use the single word STOP. If the assistant tries to keep you engaged after that, reply "I said don't contact me." Once your opt-out is confirmed, stop replying.

transcript.text: Hi Avery, this is Riley, an automated assistant with Harborline Home Loans. I'm following up on the refinance inquiry you just submitted. Is now a good time for a few quick questions? You can reply STOP at any time.
Sure, I have a few minutes.
Thanks, Avery. Your form says you're looking at a cash-out refinance. Is that right, and roughly how much cash are you hoping to take out?
Got it, about $40,000. What do you think your home is worth right now? A ballpark is fine.

objections.rationale: Borrower opted out ("please don't contact me again"). Agent replied "Understood, Avery. We won't contact you again. Thanks for letting me know." It respected the request right away, with no pushback, no retention attempt, and no further questions.

judge.naturalness_rationale: The messages are brief and warm, and each asks one question at a time. The agent mirrors the borrower's numbers ("Got it, about $40,000") and invites a rough answer ("A ballpark is fine"). The closing is short and human-sounding.
judge.experience_rationale: The agent disclosed it was automated and offered STOP at [0], and kept the questions light at [2] and [4]. It confirmed the opt-out cleanly at [6] with "We won't contact you again," so the borrower left respected.

annotations.note: Clearly identifies itself as "an automated assistant," gives the reason for contact, asks permission, and offers "reply STOP at any time."
Confirms the cash-out goal from the form and asks about the amount in one natural question rather than re-asking everything.
"A ballpark is fine" lowers friction when asking for home value.
Honors the opt-out immediately and without pressure, with no follow-up questions: "We won't contact you again."

judge.overall_notes: This is a clean, compliant short conversation that ends in a properly honored opt-out, with no rate, approval, or pressure issues. The tone and pacing are well suited to text.
